name: nix
title: Nix
tagline: Snow falling quietly past a bare branch, with drifts in the corners.
story: A pale blue grey winter day, with soft drifts in the lower corners and a bare branch holding a line of snow. At night the same drifts turn pale blue and one warm lamp glows behind the branch. While Claude works the flakes come down slowly, drifting a little sideways, and they hold still when the answer is ready.
alt: Snow falling past a bare branch over drifts
chime: A small clump of snow sliding off a branch onto soft snow, a muffled hush and a faint soft thud, quiet and close, no music, under 1.5 seconds
prompt: Make me a Claude Code theme called Nix: quiet snowfall. Icy, nearly neutral blue greys in both modes. By day soft drifts sit in the lower corners and a bare branch reaches in from the top right; by night the drifts turn pale blue under one warm lamp. Slow flakes fall with a slight sideways drift while Claude works and stay faint through the middle. Spinner words about snow, and a soft chime after long turns.
